title: Too low, too high, or correct?
heading: Too low, too high, or correct?
description: We are building a number guessing game from 1 to 100. First, help it judge one attempt. Keep the secret visible while testing. Does 30 fall below 42? Run, then try 60 and 42.

scene.label: Python output for the number guessing game.

feedback.success: < asks “is less than?”. Try > for “is greater than?”, then == for “is equal to?”. Each question gives True or False.
